# Inspection Requests

Inspection requests run inspections for a range of dates, like an inspection started from the Inspection Hub. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/inspection-requests` | [Submit an inspection request](#submit-inspection-request) |
| `GET` | `/v1/inspection-requests/{inspection_request_id}` | [Inspection request status](#get-inspection-request) |

---

## Submit an inspection request {: #submit-inspection-request }

```http
POST /v1/inspection-requests
```

**Request body**: [SubmitInspectionRequest](#submitinspectionrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Submit an inspection request | [SubmitInspectionRequestResponse](#submitinspectionrequestresponse) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `403` | Not authorized | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://digna.example.com/v1/inspection-requests' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "data_source_ids": [
      1
    ],
    "end_date": "2026-11-01",
    "include_all_data_sources": false,
    "mode": "DAILY",
    "monthly_mode_days": [
      1
    ],
    "project_id": 1,
    "start_date": "2026-11-01",
    "use_notification": false,
    "weekly_mode_weekdays": [
      "MONDAY"
    ]
  }'
```

## Inspection request status {: #get-inspection-request }

```http
GET /v1/inspection-requests/{inspection_request_id}
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inspection_request_id` | path | integer | Yes | Inspection request ID |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Inspection request status | [InspectionRequestStatusResponse](#inspectionrequeststatusresponse) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `403` | Not authorized | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `404` | Inspection request not found | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/inspection-requests/<inspection_request_id>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```

### StableInspectionRequestMode {: #stableinspectionrequestmode }

One of: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`, `MONTHLY`.

### StableInspectionRequestWeekday {: #stableinspectionrequestweekday }

One of: `MONDAY`, `TUESDAY`, `WEDNESDAY`, `THURSDAY`, `FRIDAY`, `SATURDAY`, `SUNDAY`.

### ApiErrorCode {: #apierrorcode }

One of: `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, `NOT_AUTHORIZED`, `INVALID_LICENSE`, `BAD_REQUEST`.

### StableInspectionOperationStatus {: #stableinspectionoperationstatus }

One of: `PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`, `ABORTED`, `CANCELLED`.
